operator-walkthrough.ref: Q-23 phase 11 (2026-10-01, branch nickstire/q23-phase11-lane-health). What the operator sees: Admin > Intelligence HQ, default Battlefield tab, right column, a new 'Customer lanes' card directly under 'Data freshness'. One row per scheduled customer lane (Declined-work recovery, Retention D7-D365, Win-back, Review requests, Review reminder (drafts), Weather triggers, Drip campaigns, Review + referral auto-retry), each with a coloured dot and a state word (running / blocked / stale / failing / unknown) and three lines: 'last run 1h ago · processed N', 'sent N in 30d' (plus 'K not delivered' when some failed), and 'outcome' (e.g. '+$2,000 gross vs holdout (40 vs 30 matured)' tagged ESTIMATE, 'collecting · 12 matured per arm, 30 needed', 'holdout not armed', or why the lane has no holdout), each with its MEASURED / ESTIMATE / UNMEASURED tag. A blocked or failing lane adds an amber line with the reason in the job's own words ('flag X off (not set)', 'DRY RUN: N eligible ...', 'last run failed: <first line, phones/emails masked>', '0 of N texts delivered in 30d'); a running lane adds a grey 'last run said: ...' line. The header shows 'N need a look'. If the query fails, the card shows one amber line 'Lane health could not be read · unknown, not idle' (UNMEASURED) and no lane rows. Proof is a jsdom render, not a live admin session: client/src/__tests__/lane-health-q23.test.tsx (error line with no rows, every lane drawn with state, blocked reason and last-run note, loading claims nothing, Intelligence HQ mounts the card) plus shared/laneHealth.test.ts; 27 of 27 mutants caught. Not yet seen by the operator on the installed PWA against production cron_log.
